questions.explanation: The PMF of a discrete variable is $p_X(x)=P(X=x)$, the probability of each individual value.

questions.question: How are event probabilities computed from a PMF?
options: By summing the masses of values inside the event

questions.explanation: $P(X\in A)$ is the sum of the masses $p_X(x)$ over the values $x$ inside the event $A$.
